We’re excited to introduce Pay to Play 
A simpler way to organise, join and enjoy your favourite sports sessions. 🙌

No more endless group chats.
No more chasing payments.
No more “Are we still playing tomorrow?”😅

With Pay to Play, you can create a session, invite your friends, manage players and payments, and focus on what actually matters…
Getting out there and playing. ⚽🏸🏀🎾
This is just the beginning. 🚀

Whether you’re organising the game or looking for your next one, Pay to Play is here to make playing easier.
Welcome to Pay to Play. Let’s play. 🔥
